verses.luke 1:1: Luke 1:1 Inasmuch as many have taken in hand to set in order a narrative of those things which have been fulfilled among us,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:2: Luke 1:2 just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word delivered them to us,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:3: Luke 1:3 it seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write to you an orderly account, most excellent Theophilus,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:4: Luke 1:4 that you may know the certainty of those things in which you were instructed.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:5: Luke 1:5 There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the division of Abijah. His wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:6: Luke 1:6 And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:7: Luke 1:7 But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well advanced in years.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:8: Luke 1:8 So it was, that while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:9: Luke 1:9 according to the custom of the priesthood, his lot fell to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:10: Luke 1:10 And the whole multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:11: Luke 1:11 Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:12: Luke 1:12 And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:13: Luke 1:13 But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zacharias, for your prayer is heard; and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:14: Luke 1:14 And you will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:15: Luke 1:15 For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink. He will also be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:16: Luke 1:16 And he will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:17: Luke 1:17 He will also go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, "˜to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,' and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:18: Luke 1:18 And Zacharias said to the angel, "How shall I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:19: Luke 1:19 And the angel answered and said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and was sent to speak to you and bring you these glad tidings.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:20: Luke 1:20 But behold, you will be mute and not able to speak until the day these things take place, because you did not believe my words which will be fulfilled in their own time."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:21: Luke 1:21 And the people waited for Zacharias, and marveled that he lingered so long in the temple.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:22: Luke 1:22 But when he came out, he could not speak to them; and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple, for he beckoned to them and remained speechless.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:23: Luke 1:23 So it was, as soon as the days of his service were completed, that he departed to his own house.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:24: Luke 1:24 Now after those days his wife Elizabeth conceived; and she hid herself five months, saying,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:25: Luke 1:25 "Thus the Lord has dealt with me, in the days when He looked on me, to take away my reproach among people."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:26: Luke 1:26 Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:27: Luke 1:27 to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin's name was Mary.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:28: Luke 1:28 And having come in, the angel said to her, "Rejoice, highly favored one, the Lord is with you; blessed are you among women!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:29: Luke 1:29 But when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and considered what manner of greeting this was.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:30: Luke 1:30 Then the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:31: Luke 1:31 And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bring forth a Son, and shall call His name JESUS.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:32: Luke 1:32 He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Highest; and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:33: Luke 1:33 And He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and of His kingdom there will be no end."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:34: Luke 1:34 Then Mary said to the angel, "How can this be, since I do not know a man?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:35: Luke 1:35 And the angel answered and said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Highest will overshadow you; therefore, also, that Holy One who is to be born will be called the Son of God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:36: Luke 1:36 Now indeed, Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age; and this is now the sixth month for her who was called barren.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:37: Luke 1:37 For with God nothing will be impossible."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:38: Luke 1:38 Then Mary said, "Behold the maidservant of the Lord! Let it be to me according to your word." And the angel departed from her.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:39: Luke 1:39 Now Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, to a city of Judah,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:40: Luke 1:40 and entered the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:41: Luke 1:41 And it happened, when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, that the babe leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:42: Luke 1:42 Then she spoke out with a loud voice and said, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:43: Luke 1:43 But why is this granted to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:44: Luke 1:44 For indeed, as soon as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:45: Luke 1:45 Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of those things which were told her from the Lord."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:46: Luke 1:46 And Mary said:  "My soul magnifies the Lord,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:47: Luke 1:47 And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:48: Luke 1:48 For He has regarded the lowly state of His maidservant; For behold, henceforth all generations will call me blessed.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:49: Luke 1:49 For He who is mighty has done great things for me, And holy is His name.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:50: Luke 1:50 And His mercy is on those who fear Him From generation to generation.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:51: Luke 1:51 He has shown strength with His arm;  He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:52: Luke 1:52 He has put down the mighty from their thrones, And exalted the lowly.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:53: Luke 1:53 He has filled the hungry with good things, And the rich He has sent away empty.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:54: Luke 1:54 He has helped His servant Israel,  In remembrance of His mercy,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:55: Luke 1:55 As He spoke to our fathers, To Abraham and to his seed forever."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:56: Luke 1:56 And Mary remained with her about three months, and returned to her house.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:57: Luke 1:57 Now Elizabeth's full time came for her to be delivered, and she brought forth a son.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:58: Luke 1:58 When her neighbors and relatives heard how the Lord had shown great mercy to her, they rejoiced with her.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:59: Luke 1:59 So it was, on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him by the name of his father, Zacharias.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:60: Luke 1:60 His mother answered and said, "No; he shall be called John."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:61: Luke 1:61 But they said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:62: Luke 1:62 So they made signs to his father"”what he would have him called.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:63: Luke 1:63 And he asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, saying, "His name is John." So they all marveled.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:64: Luke 1:64 Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, praising God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:65: Luke 1:65 Then fear came on all who dwelt around them; and all these sayings were discussed throughout all the hill country of Judea.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:66: Luke 1:66 And all those who heard them kept them in their hearts, saying, "What kind of child will this be?" And the hand of the Lord was with him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:67: Luke 1:67 Now his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying:(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:68: Luke 1:68 "Blessed  is the Lord God of Israel, For He has visited and redeemed His people,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:69: Luke 1:69 And has raised up a horn of salvation for us In the house of His servant David,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:70: Luke 1:70 As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets, Who have been since the world began,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:71: Luke 1:71 That we should be saved from our enemies And from the hand of all who hate us,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:72: Luke 1:72 To perform the mercy promised to our fathers And to remember His holy covenant,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:73: Luke 1:73 The oath which He swore to our father Abraham:(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:74: Luke 1:74 To grant us that we, Being delivered from the hand of our enemies, Might serve Him without fear,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:75: Luke 1:75 In holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our life.(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:76: Luke 1:76 "And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Highest; For you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:77: Luke 1:77 To give knowledge of salvation to His people By the remission of their sins,(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:78: Luke 1:78 Through the tender mercy of our God, With which the Dayspring from on high has visited us;(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:79: Luke 1:79 To give light to those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, To guide our feet into the way of peace."(NKJV)
verses.luke 1:80: Luke 1:80 So the child grew and became strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his manifestation to Israel.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:1: Luke 2:1 And it came to pass in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be registered.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:2: Luke 2:2 This census first took place while Quirinius was governing Syria.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:3: Luke 2:3 So all went to be registered, everyone to his own city.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:4: Luke 2:4 Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David,(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:5: Luke 2:5 to be registered with Mary, his betrothed wife, who was with child.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:6: Luke 2:6 So it was, that while they were there, the days were completed for her to be delivered.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:7: Luke 2:7 And she brought forth her firstborn Son, and wrapped Him in swaddling cloths, and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:8: Luke 2:8 Now there were in the same country shepherds living out in the fields, keeping watch over their flock by night.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:9: Luke 2:9 And behold, an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were greatly afraid.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:10: Luke 2:10 Then the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid, for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy which will be to all people.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:11: Luke 2:11 For there is born to you this day in the city of David a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:12: Luke 2:12 And this will be the sign to you: You will find a Babe wrapped in swaddling cloths, lying in a manger."(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:13: Luke 2:13 And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God and saying:(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:14: Luke 2:14 "Glory  to God in the highest, And on earth peace, goodwill toward men!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:15: Luke 2:15 So it was, when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, that the shepherds said to one another, "Let us now go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has come to pass, which the Lord has made known to us."(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:16: Luke 2:16 And they came with haste and found Mary and Joseph, and the Babe lying in a manger.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:17: Luke 2:17 Now when they had seen Him, they made widely known the saying which was told them concerning this Child.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:18: Luke 2:18 And all those who heard it marveled at those things which were told them by the shepherds.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:19: Luke 2:19 But Mary kept all these things and pondered them in her heart.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:20: Luke 2:20 Then the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:21: Luke 2:21 And when eight days were completed for the circumcision of the Child, His name was called JESUS, the name given by the angel before He was conceived in the womb.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:22: Luke 2:22 Now when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were completed, they brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:23: Luke 2:23 (as it is written in the law of the Lord, "Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the LORD"),(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:24: Luke 2:24 and to offer a sacrifice according to what is said in the law of the Lord, "A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons."(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:25: Luke 2:25 And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and this man was just and devout, waiting for the Consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:26: Luke 2:26 And it had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:27: Luke 2:27 So he came by the Spirit into the temple. And when the parents brought in the Child Jesus, to do for Him according to the custom of the law,(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:28: Luke 2:28 he took Him up in his arms and blessed God and said:(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:29: Luke 2:29 "Lord, now You are letting Your servant depart in peace, According to Your word;(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:30: Luke 2:30 For my eyes have seen Your salvation(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:31: Luke 2:31 Which You have prepared before the face of all peoples,(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:32: Luke 2:32 A light to bring revelation to the Gentiles, And the glory of Your people Israel."(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:33: Luke 2:33 And Joseph and His mother marveled at those things which were spoken of Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:34: Luke 2:34 Then Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary His mother, "Behold, this Child is destined for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which will be spoken against(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:35: Luke 2:35 (yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul also), that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed."(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:36: Luke 2:36 Now there was one, Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was of a great age, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity;(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:37: Luke 2:37 and this woman was a widow of about eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:38: Luke 2:38 And coming in that instant she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of Him to all those who looked for redemption in Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:39: Luke 2:39 So when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:40: Luke 2:40 And the Child grew and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom; and the grace of God was upon Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:41: Luke 2:41 His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:42: Luke 2:42 And when He was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:43: Luke 2:43 When they had finished the days, as they returned, the Boy Jesus lingered behind in Jerusalem. And Joseph and His mother did not know it;(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:44: Luke 2:44 but supposing Him to have been in the company, they went a day's journey, and sought Him among their relatives and acquaintances.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:45: Luke 2:45 So when they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:46: Luke 2:46 Now so it was that after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:47: Luke 2:47 And all who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and answers.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:48: Luke 2:48 So when they saw Him, they were amazed; and His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You done this to us? Look, Your father and I have sought You anxiously."(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:49: Luke 2:49 And He said to them, "Why did you seek Me? Did you not know that I must be  about  My Father's business?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:50: Luke 2:50 But they did not understand the statement which He spoke to them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:51: Luke 2:51 Then He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them, but His mother kept all these things in her heart.(NKJV)
verses.luke 2:52: Luke 2:52 And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:1: Luke 3:1 Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:2: Luke 3:2 while Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:3: Luke 3:3 And he went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins,(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:4: Luke 3:4 as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying:  "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "˜Prepare the way of the LORD; Make His paths straight.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:5: Luke 3:5 Every valley shall be filled And every mountain and hill brought low; The crooked places shall be made straight And the rough ways smooth;(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:6: Luke 3:6 And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:7: Luke 3:7 Then he said to the multitudes that came out to be baptized by him, "Brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:8: Luke 3:8 Therefore bear fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say to yourselves, "˜We have Abraham as our father.' For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:9: Luke 3:9 And even now the ax is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:10: Luke 3:10 So the people asked him, saying, "What shall we do then?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:11: Luke 3:11 He answered and said to them, "He who has two tunics, let him give to him who has none; and he who has food, let him do likewise."(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:12: Luke 3:12 Then tax collectors also came to be baptized, and said to him, "Teacher, what shall we do?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:13: Luke 3:13 And he said to them, "Collect no more than what is appointed for you."(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:14: Luke 3:14 Likewise the soldiers asked him, saying, "And what shall we do?" So he said to them, "Do not intimidate anyone or accuse falsely, and be content with your wages."(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:15: Luke 3:15 Now as the people were in expectation, and all reasoned in their hearts about John, whether he was the Christ or not,(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:16: Luke 3:16 John answered, saying to all, "I indeed baptize you with water; but One mightier than I is coming, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:17: Luke 3:17 His winnowing fan is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clean out His threshing floor, and gather the wheat into His barn; but the chaff He will burn with unquenchable fire."(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:18: Luke 3:18 And with many other exhortations he preached to the people.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:19: Luke 3:19 But Herod the tetrarch, being rebuked by him concerning Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:20: Luke 3:20 also added this, above all, that he shut John up in prison.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:21: Luke 3:21 When all the people were baptized, it came to pass that Jesus also was baptized; and while He prayed, the heaven was opened.(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:22: Luke 3:22 And the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him, and a voice came from heaven which said, "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased."(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:23: Luke 3:23 Now Jesus Himself began His ministry at about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:24: Luke 3:24 the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Janna, the son of Joseph,(NKJV)
verses.luke 3:25: Luke 3:25 the son of Mattathiah, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,(NKJV)

verses.luke 3:31: Luke 3:31 the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattathah, the son of Nathan, the son of David,(NKJV)

verses.luke 4:1: Luke 4:1 Then Jesus, being filled with the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:2: Luke 4:2 being tempted for forty days by the devil. And in those days He ate nothing, and afterward, when they had ended, He was hungry.(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:3: Luke 4:3 And the devil said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread."(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:4: Luke 4:4 But Jesus answered him, saying, "It is written,  "˜Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:5: Luke 4:5 Then the devil, taking Him up on a high mountain, showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:6: Luke 4:6 And the devil said to Him, "All this authority I will give You, and their glory; for this has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:7: Luke 4:7 Therefore, if You will worship before me, all will be Yours."(NKJV)
verses.luke 4:8: Luke 4:8 And Jesus answered and said to him, "Get behind Me, Satan! For it is written,  "˜You shall worship the LORD your God, and Him only you shall serve.' "(NKJV)

verses.luke 7:37: Luke 7:37 And behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at the table in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster flask of fragrant oil,(NKJV)

verses.luke 7:39: Luke 7:39 Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he spoke to himself, saying, "This Man, if He were a prophet, would know who and what manner of woman this is who is touching Him, for she is a sinner."(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:40: Luke 7:40 And Jesus answered and said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." So he said, "Teacher, say it."(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:41: Luke 7:41 "There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. One owed five hundred  denarii, and the other fifty.(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:42: Luke 7:42 And when they had nothing with which to repay, he freely forgave them both. Tell Me, therefore, which of them will love him more?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:43: Luke 7:43 Simon answered and said, "I suppose the one whom he forgave more." And He said to him, "You have rightly judged."(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:44: Luke 7:44 Then He turned to the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no  water for My feet, but she has washed My feet with her tears and wiped them with the hair of her head.(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:45: Luke 7:45 You gave Me no  kiss, but this woman has not ceased to kiss My feet since the time I came in.(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:46: Luke 7:46 You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with fragrant oil.(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:47: Luke 7:47 Therefore I say to you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little."(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:48: Luke 7:48 Then He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:49: Luke 7:49 And those who sat at the table with Him began to say to themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 7:50: Luke 7:50 Then He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:1: Luke 8:1 Now it came to pass, afterward, that He went through every city and village, preaching and bringing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God. And the twelve were with Him,(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:2: Luke 8:2 and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities"”Mary called Magdalene, out of whom had come seven demons,(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:3: Luke 8:3 and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others who provided for Him from their substance.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:4: Luke 8:4 And when a great multitude had gathered, and they had come to Him from every city, He spoke by a parable:(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:5: Luke 8:5 "A sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell by the wayside; and it was trampled down, and the birds of the air devoured it.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:6: Luke 8:6 Some fell on rock; and as soon as it sprang up, it withered away because it lacked moisture.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:7: Luke 8:7 And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up with it and choked it.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:8: Luke 8:8 But others fell on good ground, sprang up, and yielded a crop a hundredfold." When He had said these things He cried, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:9: Luke 8:9 Then His disciples asked Him, saying, "What does this parable mean?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:10: Luke 8:10 And He said, "To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest it is given in parables, that  "˜Seeing they may not see, And hearing they may not understand.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:11: Luke 8:11 "Now the parable is this: The seed is the  word of God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:12: Luke 8:12 Those by the wayside are the ones who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:13: Luke 8:13 But the ones on the rock are those who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who believe for a while and in time of temptation fall away.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:14: Luke 8:14 Now the ones that fell among thorns are those who, when they have heard, go out and are choked with cares,  riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:15: Luke 8:15 But the ones that fell on the good ground are those who, having heard the word with a noble and good heart, keep it and bear fruit with  patience.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:16: Luke 8:16 "No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a vessel or puts it under a bed, but sets it on a lampstand, that those who enter may see the  light.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:17: Luke 8:17 For nothing is secret that will not be  revealed, nor anything hidden that will not be known and come to light.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:18: Luke 8:18 Therefore take heed how you hear.  For whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he seems to  have will be taken from him."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:19: Luke 8:19 Then His mother and brothers came to Him, and could not approach Him because of the crowd.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:20: Luke 8:20 And it was told Him by some, who said, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, desiring to see You."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:21: Luke 8:21 But He answered and said to them, "My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:22: Luke 8:22 Now it happened, on a certain day, that He got into a boat with His disciples. And He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side of the lake." And they launched out.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:23: Luke 8:23 But as they sailed He fell asleep. And a windstorm came down on the lake, and they were filling with water, and were in jeopardy.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:24: Luke 8:24 And they came to Him and awoke Him, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" Then He arose and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water. And they ceased, and there was a calm.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:25: Luke 8:25 But He said to them, "Where is your faith?" And they were afraid, and marveled, saying to one another, "Who can this be? For He commands even the winds and water, and they obey Him!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:26: Luke 8:26 Then they sailed to the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:27: Luke 8:27 And when He stepped out on the land, there met Him a certain man from the city who had demons for a long time. And he wore no clothes, nor did he live in a house but in the tombs.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:28: Luke 8:28 When he saw Jesus, he cried out, fell down before Him, and with a loud voice said, "What have I to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:29: Luke 8:29 For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For it had often seized him, and he was kept under guard, bound with chains and shackles; and he broke the bonds and was driven by the demon into the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:30: Luke 8:30 Jesus asked him, saying, "What is your name?" And he said, "Legion," because many demons had entered him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:31: Luke 8:31 And they begged Him that He would not command them to go out into the abyss.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:32: Luke 8:32 Now a herd of many swine was feeding there on the mountain. So they begged Him that He would permit them to enter them. And He permitted them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:33: Luke 8:33 Then the demons went out of the man and entered the swine, and the herd ran violently down the steep place into the lake and drowned.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:34: Luke 8:34 When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:35: Luke 8:35 Then they went out to see what had happened, and came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:36: Luke 8:36 They also who had seen it told them by what means he who had been demon-possessed was healed.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:37: Luke 8:37 Then the whole multitude of the surrounding region of the Gadarenes asked Him to depart from them, for they were seized with great fear. And He got into the boat and returned.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:38: Luke 8:38 Now the man from whom the demons had departed begged Him that he might be with Him. But Jesus sent him away, saying,(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:39: Luke 8:39 "Return to your own house, and tell what great things God has done for you." And he went his way and proclaimed throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:40: Luke 8:40 So it was, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed Him, for they were all waiting for Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:41: Luke 8:41 And behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. And he fell down at Jesus' feet and begged Him to come to his house,(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:42: Luke 8:42 for he had an only daughter about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as He went, the multitudes thronged Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:43: Luke 8:43 Now a woman, having a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her livelihood on physicians and could not be healed by any,(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:44: Luke 8:44 came from behind and touched the border of His garment. And immediately her flow of blood stopped.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:45: Luke 8:45 And Jesus said, "Who touched Me?" When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, "Master, the multitudes throng and press You, and You say, "˜Who touched Me?' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:46: Luke 8:46 But Jesus said, "Somebody touched Me, for I perceived  power going out from Me."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:47: Luke 8:47 Now when the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before Him, she declared to Him in the presence of all the people the reason she had touched Him and how she was healed immediately.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:48: Luke 8:48 And He said to her, "Daughter, be of good cheer; your faith has made you well.  Go in peace."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:49: Luke 8:49 While He was still speaking, someone came from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, "Your daughter is dead. Do not trouble the Teacher."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:50: Luke 8:50 But when Jesus heard it, He answered him, saying, "Do not be afraid;  only believe, and she will be made well."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:51: Luke 8:51 When He came into the house, He permitted no one to go in except Peter, James, and John, and the father and mother of the girl.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:52: Luke 8:52 Now all wept and mourned for her; but He said, "Do not weep; she is not dead,  but sleeping."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:53: Luke 8:53 And they ridiculed Him, knowing that she was dead.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:54: Luke 8:54 But He put them all outside, took her by the hand and called, saying, "Little girl,  arise."(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:55: Luke 8:55 Then her spirit returned, and she arose immediately. And He commanded that she be given something to eat.(NKJV)
verses.luke 8:56: Luke 8:56 And her parents were astonished, but He charged them to tell no one what had happened.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:1: Luke 9:1 Then He called His twelve disciples together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:2: Luke 9:2 He sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:3: Luke 9:3 And He said to them, "Take nothing for the journey, neither staffs nor bag nor bread nor money; and do not have two tunics apiece.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:4: Luke 9:4 "Whatever house you enter, stay there, and from there depart.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:5: Luke 9:5 And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city,  shake off the very dust from your feet as a testimony against them."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:6: Luke 9:6 So they departed and went through the towns, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:7: Luke 9:7 Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by Him; and he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:8: Luke 9:8 and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:9: Luke 9:9 Herod said, "John I have beheaded, but who is this of whom I hear such things?" So he sought to see Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:10: Luke 9:10 And the apostles, when they had returned, told Him all that they had done. Then He took them and went aside privately into a deserted place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:11: Luke 9:11 But when the multitudes knew it, they followed Him; and He received them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who had need of healing.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:12: Luke 9:12 When the day began to wear away, the twelve came and said to Him, "Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding towns and country, and lodge and get provisions; for we are in a deserted place here."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:13: Luke 9:13 But He said to them, "You give them something to eat." And they said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we go and buy food for all these people."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:14: Luke 9:14 For there were about five thousand men. Then He said to His disciples, "Make them sit down in groups of fifty."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:15: Luke 9:15 And they did so, and made them all sit down.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:16: Luke 9:16 Then He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:17: Luke 9:17 So they all ate and were filled, and twelve baskets of the leftover fragments were taken up by them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:18: Luke 9:18 And it happened, as He was alone praying, that His disciples joined Him, and He asked them, saying, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:19: Luke 9:19 So they answered and said, "John the Baptist, but some say Elijah; and others say that one of the old prophets has risen again."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:20: Luke 9:20 He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?"  Peter answered and said, "The Christ of God."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:21: Luke 9:21 And He strictly warned and commanded them to tell this to no one,(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:22: Luke 9:22 saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:23: Luke 9:23 Then He said to them all, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:24: Luke 9:24 For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:25: Luke 9:25 For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and is himself destroyed or lost?(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:26: Luke 9:26 For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, of him the Son of Man will be  ashamed when He comes in His own glory, and in His Father's, and of the holy angels.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:27: Luke 9:27 But I tell you truly, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the kingdom of God."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:28: Luke 9:28 Now it came to pass, about eight days after these sayings, that He took Peter, John, and James and went up on the mountain to pray.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:29: Luke 9:29 As He prayed, the appearance of His face was altered, and His robe became white and glistening.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:30: Luke 9:30 And behold, two men talked with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:31: Luke 9:31 who appeared in glory and spoke of His decease which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:32: Luke 9:32 But Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep; and when they were fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who stood with Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:33: Luke 9:33 Then it happened, as they were parting from Him, that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah""”not knowing what he said.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:34: Luke 9:34 While he was saying this, a cloud came and overshadowed them; and they were fearful as they entered the cloud.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:35: Luke 9:35 And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:36: Luke 9:36 When the voice had ceased, Jesus was found alone. But they kept quiet, and told no one in those days any of the things they had seen.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:37: Luke 9:37 Now it happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:38: Luke 9:38 Suddenly a man from the multitude cried out, saying, "Teacher, I implore You, look on my son, for he is my only child.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:39: Luke 9:39 And behold, a spirit seizes him, and he suddenly cries out; it convulses him so that he foams at the mouth; and it departs from him with great difficulty, bruising him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:40: Luke 9:40 So I implored Your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:41: Luke 9:41 Then Jesus answered and said, "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:42: Luke 9:42 And as he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him. Then Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the child, and gave him back to his father.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:43: Luke 9:43 And they were all amazed at the majesty of God. But while everyone marveled at all the things which Jesus did, He said to His disciples,(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:44: Luke 9:44 "Let these words sink down into your ears, for the Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:45: Luke 9:45 But they did not understand this saying, and it was hidden from them so that they did not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this saying.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:46: Luke 9:46 Then a dispute arose among them as to which of them would be greatest.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:47: Luke 9:47 And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a little child and set him by Him,(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:48: Luke 9:48 and said to them, "Whoever receives this little child in My name receives Me; and  whoever receives Me  receives Him who sent Me.  For he who is least among you all will be great."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:49: Luke 9:49 Now John answered and said, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we forbade him because he does not follow with us."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:50: Luke 9:50 But Jesus said to him, "Do not forbid him, for  he who is not against us is on our side."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:51: Luke 9:51 Now it came to pass, when the time had come for Him to be received up, that He steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem,(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:52: Luke 9:52 and sent messengers before His face. And as they went, they entered a village of the Samaritans, to prepare for Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:53: Luke 9:53 But they did not receive Him, because His face was set for the journey to Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:54: Luke 9:54 And when His disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them, just as Elijah did?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:55: Luke 9:55 But He turned and rebuked them, and said, "You do not know what manner of  spirit you are of.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:56: Luke 9:56 For  the Son of Man did not come to destroy men's lives but to save them." And they went to another village.(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:57: Luke 9:57 Now it happened as they journeyed on the road, that someone said to Him, "Lord, I will follow You wherever You go."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:58: Luke 9:58 And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man  has nowhere to lay His head."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:59: Luke 9:59 Then He said to another, "Follow Me." But he said, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:60: Luke 9:60 Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and preach the kingdom of God."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:61: Luke 9:61 And another also said, "Lord, I will follow You, but let me first go and bid them farewell who are at my house."(NKJV)
verses.luke 9:62: Luke 9:62 But Jesus said to him, "No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is  fit for the kingdom of God."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:1: Luke 10:1 After these things the Lord appointed seventy others also, and sent them two by two before His face into every city and place where He Himself was about to go.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:2: Luke 10:2 Then He said to them, "The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few; therefore  pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:3: Luke 10:3 Go your way;  behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:4: Luke 10:4 Carry neither money bag, knapsack, nor sandals; and  greet no one along the road.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:5: Luke 10:5 But whatever house you enter, first say, "˜Peace to this house.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:6: Luke 10:6 And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on it; if not, it will return to you.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:7: Luke 10:7 And remain in the same house,  eating and drinking such things as they give, for  the laborer is worthy of his wages. Do not go from house to house.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:8: Luke 10:8 Whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:9: Luke 10:9 And heal the sick there, and say to them,  "˜The kingdom of God has come near to you.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:10: Luke 10:10 But whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, go out into its streets and say,(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:11: Luke 10:11 "˜The very dust of your city which clings to us we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:12: Luke 10:12 But I say to you that  it will be more tolerable in that Day for Sodom than for that city.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:13: Luke 10:13 "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida!  For if the mighty works which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:14: Luke 10:14 But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:15: Luke 10:15 And you, Capernaum, who are  exalted to heaven,  will be brought down to Hades.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:16: Luke 10:16 He who hears you hears Me,  he who rejects you rejects Me, and  he who rejects Me rejects Him who sent Me."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:17: Luke 10:17 Then the seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:18: Luke 10:18 And He said to them, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:19: Luke 10:19 Behold,  I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:20: Luke 10:20 Nevertheless do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rather rejoice because  your names are written in heaven."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:21: Luke 10:21 In that hour Jesus rejoiced in the Spirit and said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and revealed them to babes. Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight.(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:22: Luke 10:22 All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and  no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and the one to whom the Son wills to reveal Him."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:23: Luke 10:23 Then He turned to His disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes which see the things you see;(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:24: Luke 10:24 for I tell you  that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen it, and to hear what you hear, and have not heard it."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:25: Luke 10:25 And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested Him, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:26: Luke 10:26 He said to him, "What is written in the law? What is your reading of it?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:27: Luke 10:27 So he answered and said, " "˜You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind,' and "˜your neighbor as yourself.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:28: Luke 10:28 And He said to him, "You have answered rightly; do this and  you will live."(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:29: Luke 10:29 But he, wanting to justify himself, said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 10:30: Luke 10:30 Then Jesus answered and said: "A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, who stripped him of his clothing, wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:7: Luke 14:7 So He told a parable to those who were invited, when He noted how they chose the best places, saying to them:(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:8: Luke 14:8 "When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, do not sit down in the best place, lest one more honorable than you be invited by him;(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:12: Luke 14:12 Then He also said to him who invited Him, "When you give a dinner or a supper, do not ask your friends, your brothers, your relatives, nor rich neighbors, lest they also invite you back, and you be repaid.(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:15: Luke 14:15 Now when one of those who sat at the table with Him heard these things, he said to Him, "Blessed is he who shall eat bread in the kingdom of God!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:16: Luke 14:16 Then He said to him, "A certain man gave a great supper and invited many,(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:22: Luke 14:22 And the servant said, "˜Master, it is done as you commanded, and still there is room.'(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:24: Luke 14:24 For I say to you  that none of those men who were invited shall taste my supper.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:25: Luke 14:25 Now great multitudes went with Him. And He turned and said to them,(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:26: Luke 14:26 "If anyone comes to Me  and does not hate his father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters,  yes, and his own life also, he cannot be My disciple.(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:27: Luke 14:27 And  whoever does not bear his cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:29: Luke 14:29 lest, after he has laid the foundation, and is not able to finish, all who see it begin to mock him,(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:30: Luke 14:30 saying, "˜This man began to build and was not able to finish'?(NKJV)
verses.luke 14:31: Luke 14:31 Or what king, going to make war against another king, does not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?(NKJV)

verses.luke 14:34: Luke 14:34 "Salt is good; but if the salt has lost its flavor, how shall it be seasoned?(NKJV)

verses.luke 15:1: Luke 15:1 Then all the tax collectors and the sinners drew near to Him to hear Him.(NKJV)

verses.luke 15:11: Luke 15:11 Then He said: "A certain man had two sons.(NKJV)

verses.luke 15:13: Luke 15:13 And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together, journeyed to a far country, and there wasted his possessions with prodigal living.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:14: Luke 15:14 But when he had spent all, there arose a severe famine in that land, and he began to be in want.(NKJV)

verses.luke 15:16: Luke 15:16 And he would gladly have filled his stomach with the pods that the swine ate, and no one gave him anything.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:17: Luke 15:17 "But when he came to himself, he said, "˜How many of my father's hired servants have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!(NKJV)

verses.luke 15:19: Luke 15:19 and I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants." '(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:20: Luke 15:20 "And he arose and came to his father. But  when he was still a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:21: Luke 15:21 And the son said to him, "˜Father, I have sinned against heaven  and in your sight, and am no longer worthy to be called your son.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:22: Luke 15:22 "But the father said to his servants, "˜Bring out the best robe and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.(NKJV)

verses.luke 15:24: Luke 15:24 for this my son was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' And they began to be merry.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:25: Luke 15:25 "Now his older son was in the field. And as he came and drew near to the house, he heard music and dancing.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:26: Luke 15:26 So he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:27: Luke 15:27 And he said to him, "˜Your brother has come, and because he has received him safe and sound, your father has killed the fatted calf.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:28: Luke 15:28 "But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and pleaded with him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:29: Luke 15:29 So he answered and said to his father, "˜Lo, these many years I have been serving you; I never transgressed your commandment at any time; and yet you never gave me a young goat, that I might make merry with my friends.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:30: Luke 15:30 But as soon as this son of yours came, who has devoured your livelihood with harlots, you killed the fatted calf for him.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:31: Luke 15:31 "And he said to him, "˜Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.(NKJV)
verses.luke 15:32: Luke 15:32 It was right that we should make merry and be glad,  for your brother was dead and is alive again, and was lost and is found.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:1: Luke 16:1 He also said to His disciples: "There was a certain rich man who had a steward, and an accusation was brought to him that this man was wasting his goods.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:2: Luke 16:2 So he called him and said to him, "˜What is this I hear about you? Give an  account of your stewardship, for you can no longer be steward.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:3: Luke 16:3 "Then the steward said within himself, "˜What shall I do? For my master is taking the stewardship away from me. I cannot dig; I am ashamed to beg.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:4: Luke 16:4 I have resolved what to do, that when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:5: Luke 16:5 "So he called every one of his master's debtors to him, and said to the first, "˜How much do you owe my master?'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:6: Luke 16:6 And he said, "˜A hundred measures of oil.' So he said to him, "˜Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:7: Luke 16:7 Then he said to another, "˜And how much do you owe?' So he said, "˜A hundred measures of wheat.' And he said to him, "˜Take your bill, and write eighty.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:8: Luke 16:8 So the master commended the unjust steward because he had dealt shrewdly. For the sons of this world are more shrewd in their generation than  the sons of light.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:9: Luke 16:9 "And I say to you,  make friends for yourselves by unrighteous mammon, that when you fail, they may receive you into an everlasting home.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:10: Luke 16:10 He who is faithful in what is least is faithful also in much; and he who is unjust in what is least is unjust also in much.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:11: Luke 16:11 Therefore if you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:12: Luke 16:12 And if you have not been faithful in what is another man's, who will give you what is your  own?(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:13: Luke 16:13 "No servant can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be loyal to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon."(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:14: Luke 16:14 Now the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they derided Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:15: Luke 16:15 And He said to them, "You are those who  justify yourselves  before men, but  God knows your hearts. For  what is highly esteemed among men is an abomination in the sight of God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:16: Luke 16:16 "The law and the prophets were until John. Since that time the kingdom of God has been preached, and everyone is pressing into it.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:17: Luke 16:17 And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tittle of the law to fail.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:18: Luke 16:18 "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery; and whoever marries her who is divorced from her husband commits adultery.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:19: Luke 16:19 "There was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and fared sumptuously every day.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:20: Luke 16:20 But there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, full of sores, who was laid at his gate,(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:21: Luke 16:21 desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table. Moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:22: Luke 16:22 So it was that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels to  Abraham's bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:23: Luke 16:23 And being in torments in Hades, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:24: Luke 16:24 "Then he cried and said, "˜Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and  cool my tongue; for I  am tormented in this flame.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:25: Luke 16:25 But Abraham said, "˜Son,  remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things; but now he is comforted and you are tormented.(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:26: Luke 16:26 And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, so that those who want to pass from here to you cannot, nor can those from there pass to us.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:27: Luke 16:27 "Then he said, "˜I beg you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house,(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:28: Luke 16:28 for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, lest they also come to this place of torment.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:29: Luke 16:29 Abraham said to him,  "˜They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:30: Luke 16:30 And he said, "˜No, father Abraham; but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.'(NKJV)
verses.luke 16:31: Luke 16:31 But he said to him,  "˜If they do not hear Moses and the prophets,  neither will they be persuaded though one rise from the dead.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 17:1: Luke 17:1 Then He said to the disciples, "It is impossible that no offenses should come, but  woe to him through whom they do come!(NKJV)
verses.luke 17:2: Luke 17:2 It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.(NKJV)

verses.luke 17:31: Luke 17:31 "In that day, he  who is on the housetop, and his goods are in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise the one who is in the field, let him not turn back.(NKJV)

verses.luke 17:37: Luke 17:37 And they answered and said to Him, "Where, Lord?" So He said to them, "Wherever the body is, there the eagles will be gathered together."(NKJV)
verses.luke 18:1: Luke 18:1 Then He spoke a parable to them, that men always ought to pray and not lose heart,(NKJV)

verses.luke 18:10: Luke 18:10 "Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.(NKJV)

verses.luke 18:15: Luke 18:15 Then they also brought infants to Him that He might touch them; but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:39: Luke 22:39 Coming out, He went to the Mount of Olives, as He was accustomed, and His disciples also followed Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:40: Luke 22:40 When He came to the place, He said to them, "Pray that you may not enter into temptation."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:41: Luke 22:41 And He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and He knelt down and prayed,(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:42: Luke 22:42 saying, "Father, if it is Your will, take this cup away from Me; nevertheless  not My will, but Yours, be done."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:43: Luke 22:43 Then an angel appeared to Him from heaven, strengthening Him.(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:46: Luke 22:46 Then He said to them, "Why  do you sleep? Rise and  pray, lest you enter into temptation."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:47: Luke 22:47 And while He was still speaking, behold, a multitude; and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them and drew near to Jesus to kiss Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:48: Luke 22:48 But Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a  kiss?"(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:52: Luke 22:52 Then Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and the elders who had come to Him, "Have you come out, as against a  robber, with swords and clubs?(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:53: Luke 22:53 When I was with you daily in the  temple, you did not try to seize Me. But this is your  hour, and the power of darkness."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:54: Luke 22:54 Having arrested Him, they led Him and brought Him into the high priest's house. But Peter followed at a distance.(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:55: Luke 22:55 Now when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:57: Luke 22:57 But he denied Him, saying, "Woman, I do not know Him."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:58: Luke 22:58 And after a little while another saw him and said, "You also are of them." But Peter said, "Man, I am not!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:59: Luke 22:59 Then after about an hour had passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, "Surely this fellow also was with Him, for he is a Galilean."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:60: Luke 22:60 But Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are saying!" Immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:62: Luke 22:62 So Peter went out and wept bitterly.(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:64: Luke 22:64 And having blindfolded Him, they struck Him on the face and asked Him, saying, "Prophesy! Who is the one who struck You?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:65: Luke 22:65 And many other things they blasphemously spoke against Him.(NKJV)

verses.luke 22:67: Luke 22:67 "If You are the Christ, tell us." But He said to them, "If I tell you, you will  by no means believe.(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:68: Luke 22:68 And if I also ask you, you will by no means answer Me or let Me go.(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:69: Luke 22:69 Hereafter the Son of Man will sit on the right hand of the power of God."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:70: Luke 22:70 Then they all said, "Are You then the Son of God?" So He said to them, "You rightly say that I am."(NKJV)
verses.luke 22:71: Luke 22:71 And they said, "What further testimony do we need? For we have heard it ourselves from His own mouth."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:1: Luke 23:1 Then the whole multitude of them arose and led Him to Pilate.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:2: Luke 23:2 And they began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to pay taxes to Caesar, saying that He Himself is Christ, a King."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:3: Luke 23:3 Then Pilate asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him and said, "It is as you say."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:4: Luke 23:4 So Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no fault in this Man."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:5: Luke 23:5 But they were the more fierce, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:6: Luke 23:6 When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked if the Man were a Galilean.(NKJV)

verses.luke 23:9: Luke 23:9 Then he questioned Him with many words, but He answered him nothing.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:10: Luke 23:10 And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:11: Luke 23:11 Then Herod, with his men of war, treated Him with contempt and mocked Him, arrayed Him in a gorgeous robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:12: Luke 23:12 That very day Pilate and Herod became friends with each other, for previously they had been at enmity with each other.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:13: Luke 23:13 Then Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:14: Luke 23:14 said to them, "You have brought this Man to me, as one who misleads the people. And indeed, having examined Him in your presence, I have found no fault in this Man concerning those things of which you accuse Him;(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:15: Luke 23:15 no, neither did Herod, for I sent you back to him; and indeed nothing deserving of death has been done by Him.(NKJV)

verses.luke 23:17: Luke 23:17 (for it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast).(NKJV)

verses.luke 23:19: Luke 23:19 who had been thrown into prison for a certain rebellion made in the city, and for murder.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:20: Luke 23:20 Pilate, therefore, wishing to release Jesus, again called out to them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:21: Luke 23:21 But they shouted, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:22: Luke 23:22 Then he said to them the third time, "Why, what evil has He done? I have found no reason for death in Him. I will therefore chastise Him and let Him go."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:23: Luke 23:23 But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. And the voices of these men and of the chief priests prevailed.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:24: Luke 23:24 So Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they requested.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:25: Luke 23:25 And he released to them the one they requested, who for rebellion and murder had been thrown into prison; but he delivered Jesus to their will.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:26: Luke 23:26 Now as they led Him away, they laid hold of a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, who was coming from the country, and on him they laid the cross that he might bear it after Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:27: Luke 23:27 And a great multitude of the people followed Him, and women who also mourned and lamented Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:28: Luke 23:28 But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:29: Luke 23:29 For indeed the days are coming in which they will say, "˜Blessed are the barren, wombs that never bore, and breasts which never nursed!'(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:30: Luke 23:30 Then they will begin  "˜to say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!" '(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:31: Luke 23:31 For if they do these things in the green wood, what will be done in the dry?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:32: Luke 23:32 There were also two others, criminals, led with Him to be put to death.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:33: Luke 23:33 And when they had come to the place called Calvary, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and the other on the left.(NKJV)

verses.luke 23:36: Luke 23:36 The soldiers also mocked Him, coming and offering Him sour wine,(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:37: Luke 23:37 and saying, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:38: Luke 23:38 And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.(NKJV)

verses.luke 23:40: Luke 23:40 But the other, answering, rebuked him, saying, "Do you not even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?(NKJV)

verses.luke 23:42: Luke 23:42 Then he said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:43: Luke 23:43 And Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you, today you will be with Me in  Paradise."(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:44: Luke 23:44 Now it was about the sixth hour, and there was darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:45: Luke 23:45 Then the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:46: Luke 23:46 And when Jesus had cried out with a loud voice, He said, "Father,  "˜into Your hands I commit My spirit.' " Having said this, He breathed His last.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:47: Luke 23:47 So when the centurion saw what had happened, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous Man!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:48: Luke 23:48 And the whole crowd who came together to that sight, seeing what had been done, beat their breasts and returned.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:49: Luke 23:49 But all His acquaintances, and the women who followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:50: Luke 23:50 Now behold, there was a man named Joseph, a council member, a good and just man.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:51: Luke 23:51 He had not consented to their decision and deed. He was from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who himself was also waiting for the kingdom of God.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:52: Luke 23:52 This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:53: Luke 23:53 Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a tomb that was hewn out of the rock, where no one had ever lain before.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:54: Luke 23:54 That day was the Preparation, and the Sabbath drew near.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:55: Luke 23:55 And the women who had come with Him from Galilee followed after, and they observed the tomb and how His body was laid.(NKJV)
verses.luke 23:56: Luke 23:56 Then they returned and prepared spices and fragrant oils. And they rested on the Sabbath according to the commandment.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:1: Luke 24:1 Now on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they, and certain other women with them, came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:2: Luke 24:2 But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:3: Luke 24:3 Then they went in and did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:4: Luke 24:4 And it happened, as they were greatly perplexed about this, that behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:5: Luke 24:5 Then, as they were afraid and bowed their faces to the earth, they said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:6: Luke 24:6 He is not here, but is risen! Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:7: Luke 24:7 saying, "˜The Son of Man must be  delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.' "(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:8: Luke 24:8 And they remembered His words.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:9: Luke 24:9 Then they returned from the tomb and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.(NKJV)

verses.luke 24:11: Luke 24:11 And their words seemed to them like idle tales, and they did not believe them.(NKJV)

verses.luke 24:13: Luke 24:13 Now behold, two of them were traveling that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was seven miles from Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:14: Luke 24:14 And they talked together of all these things which had happened.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:15: Luke 24:15 So it was, while they conversed and reasoned, that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:16: Luke 24:16 But their eyes were restrained, so that they did not know Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:17: Luke 24:17 And He said to them, "What kind of conversation is this that you have with one another as you walk and are sad?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:18: Luke 24:18 Then the one whose name was Cleopas answered and said to Him, "Are You the only stranger in Jerusalem, and have You not known the things which happened there in these days?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:19: Luke 24:19 And He said to them, "What things?" So they said to Him, "The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a Prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:20: Luke 24:20 and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to be condemned to death, and crucified Him.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:21: Luke 24:21 But we were hoping that it was He who was going to redeem Israel. Indeed, besides all this, today is the third day since these things happened.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:22: Luke 24:22 Yes, and certain women of our company, who arrived at the tomb early, astonished us.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:23: Luke 24:23 When they did not find His body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who said He was alive.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:24: Luke 24:24 And certain of those who were with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said; but Him they did not see."(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:25: Luke 24:25 Then He said to them, "O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!(NKJV)

verses.luke 24:27: Luke 24:27 And beginning at Moses and all the Prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:28: Luke 24:28 Then they drew near to the village where they were going, and He indicated that He would have gone farther.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:29: Luke 24:29 But they constrained Him, saying, "Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent." And He went in to stay with them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:30: Luke 24:30 Now it came to pass, as He sat at the table with them, that He took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:31: Luke 24:31 Then their eyes were opened and they knew Him; and He vanished from their sight.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:32: Luke 24:32 And they said to one another, "Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us on the road, and while He opened the Scriptures to us?"(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:33: Luke 24:33 So they rose up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and those who were with them gathered together,(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:34: Luke 24:34 saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:35: Luke 24:35 And they told about the things that had happened on the road, and how He was known to them in the breaking of bread.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:36: Luke 24:36 Now as they said these things, Jesus Himself stood in the midst of them, and said to them, "Peace to you."(NKJV)

verses.luke 24:38: Luke 24:38 And He said to them, "Why are you troubled? And why do doubts arise in your hearts?(NKJV)

verses.luke 24:40: Luke 24:40 When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.(NKJV)

verses.luke 24:42: Luke 24:42 So they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:43: Luke 24:43 And He took it and ate in their presence.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:44: Luke 24:44 Then He said to them, "These are the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms concerning Me."(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:45: Luke 24:45 And He opened their understanding, that they might comprehend the Scriptures.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:46: Luke 24:46 Then He said to them, "Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:47: Luke 24:47 and that repentance and  remission of sins should be preached in His name  to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:48: Luke 24:48 And  you are witnesses of these things.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:49: Luke 24:49 Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high."(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:50: Luke 24:50 And He led them out as far as Bethany, and He lifted up His hands and blessed them.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:51: Luke 24:51 Now it came to pass, while He blessed them, that He was parted from them and carried up into heaven.(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:52: Luke 24:52 And they worshiped Him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,(NKJV)
verses.luke 24:53: Luke 24:53 and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God. Amen.(NKJV)
